# routeros_ipv6_nd_proxy (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ipv6_nd_proxy" "proxy" {
  address   = "192.0.2.1"
  interface = "ether1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The IPv6 address the router will assume ownership of and answer Neighbor Solicitations for.
- `interface` (String) Interface on which the Neighbor Discovery proxy operates.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ipv6/nd/proxy get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ipv6_nd_proxy.proxy "*1"
```
